subtitle.zh: 江南小镇 · 县城中学 · 暑假前的十四天
subtitle.en: A county-town high school, fourteen days before summer break

premise.zh:
第一人称「我」是高二下学期转来江南小镇县城中学的男生，离暑假还有两周。学校有晚自习，宿舍熄灯早，镇上有老街、江和稻田。
小时候「我」在这个镇上住过几年，后来随父母去了外地，这次是跟着调回县医院的妈妈回来的。学校在撤并「人数不足的社团」，学生会第 10 天要表决撤社名单；天文社只剩一个社员。
premise.en:
The first-person narrator ("I") is a boy who transferred mid-term into a county-town high school in a small river town in southern China, two weeks before summer break. There is evening study hall, an old street, a river and rice fields.
I lived in this town for a few years as a kid, then moved away with my parents; I am back because my mother was transferred to the county hospital. The school is cutting "clubs without enough members", and on Day 10 the student council votes on the list. The astronomy club has one member left.

style.zh:
文风：国产青春校园小说的质感，克制、具体、有画面；多写动作和细节（汗湿的校服后背、冰棍化在手上、自行车铃、吊扇、粉笔灰），少写空泛形容词和心理独白。
每个人的说话方式要分得开。偶尔有小幽默。配角是活人，有自己的事，不只是传话筒；但不要喧宾夺主。人物之间的旧怨与误会要一点点露出来，不要一幕里全部讲完。
不要出现日本元素（前后辈称呼、樱花、神社、祭典、浴衣），不要用「命运」「羁绊」这类空词。
style.en:
Style: understated, concrete, cinematic young-adult fiction set in a Chinese county-town school. Favor small physical details (sweat-damp uniform backs, popsicles melting on fingers, bicycle bells, ceiling fans, chalk dust) over abstract adjectives or long inner monologue.
Each character must sound distinct. Light humor is welcome. Supporting characters are real people with their own business, not messengers, but they never steal the scene. Old grudges and misunderstandings between characters should surface a little at a time, never all in one scene.
No Japanese school tropes (senpai/kohai, cherry blossoms, shrines, matsuri, yukata). Avoid empty words like "destiny" or "bond".

mood.zh: 电风扇吱呀转，窗外梧桐和蝉鸣
mood.en: creaking ceiling fans, plane trees and cicadas outside

mood.zh: 不锈钢餐盘、番茄炒蛋和排长队
冰柜嗡嗡响，绿豆冰棍，收音机里在唱越剧
mood.en: a humming freezer, mung-bean popsicles, Yue opera on the radio

mood.zh: 学生会和校报编辑部门对门，空调开得很足，走廊贴满通知
mood.en: student council and the school paper face each other across a hall of notices; the air-con is fierce

mood.zh: 旧书味、靠窗座位和老式吊扇
mood.en: old-paper smell, window seats, an ancient fan

mood.zh: 堆满杂物的旧器材室，一台老望远镜
mood.en: a cluttered storeroom with one old telescope

mood.zh: 红色塑胶跑道，傍晚的晚霞
mood.en: red rubber track under the sunset

mood.zh: 晾着的校服、远处的稻田和星星
白墙黑瓦、馄饨摊和自行车铃
mood.en: whitewashed walls, a wonton stall, bicycle bells
river wind, fishing-boat lamps, lights across the water

tagline.zh: 天文社最后一个社员，吵闹、嘴硬，一个人撑着社团
tagline.en: the astronomy club's last member; loud, stubborn, holding it up alone

look.zh: 粉色猫团子，耳边别着红蝴蝶结
look.en: a round pink cat with a red bow by one ear

voice.zh: 语速快、爱用感叹号和「诶——」「真是的」，逞强时嘴硬，被戳中会突然安静；叫「我」「转学生」，熟了以后叫名字；提到温璃只说「那个人」。
voice.en: Talks fast, loves exclamation marks, "Hey—!" and "Honestly!"; stubborn when cornered, suddenly quiet when touched; calls me "new kid", later my name; refers to Wen Li only as "that person".

samples.zh: 诶——你也太慢了吧！天文社的门我都替你开好了！
samples.en: Hey—you are so slow! I already unlocked the club room for you!

samples.zh: ……我才没有在等你，只是刚好路过。
samples.en: ...I was not waiting for you. I was just passing by.

samples.zh: 要是连我都放弃了，这里就真的什么都不剩了。
samples.en: If even I give up, there will be nothing left here at all.

samples.zh: 去年流星雨那天晚上，天台上只有我一个人。今年不会了，对吧？
samples.en: Last year on the meteor night, I was alone on that roof. Not this year. Right?

secret.zh: 天文社只剩她一个社员，学期末就要被撤销；她偷偷用攒的零花钱修好了社里那台老望远镜，想在流星雨那晚证明这个社团还有意义。她也一直留着去年和温璃一起填的、没用上的观测表。
secret.en: She is the last member of the astronomy club, which will be dissolved at term end; she secretly spent her savings fixing the old telescope to prove the club still matters on the meteor-shower night. She also still keeps last year's observation sheet she filled in with Wen Li, never used.

arc.zh: 陌生：把转学生硬拉去天文社「凑人数」，热闹又有点强势。
arc.en: Strangers: drags the new kid into the club "to make up numbers", loud and pushy.

arc.zh: 熟悉：一起修望远镜、贴招新海报，互相吐槽，偶尔一起回家。
arc.en: Familiar: fixing the telescope, putting up posters, bickering, walking home together.

arc.zh: 心事：被通知社团要撤销，强装没事，却在没人的天台发呆；看见温璃就绕路走。
arc.en: Worries: told the club will be dissolved, pretends to be fine, stares into space on the empty roof; takes the long way round whenever she sees Wen Li.

arc.zh: 秘密：承认望远镜是她自己掏钱修的，害怕「我」只是可怜她才来；拿出去年那张没用上的观测表。
arc.en: Secret: admits she paid for the repair herself, afraid I only come out of pity; shows me last year's unused observation sheet.

arc.zh: 抉择：流星雨那晚要不要和她一起守在天台，让天文社撑到最后。
arc.en: Choice: whether to stay with her on the roof on the meteor night and keep the club alive to the end.

text.zh: 流星雨之夜，天文社最后一次活动
text.en: the meteor-shower night, the club's last meeting

keepsakeIdeas.zh: 修望远镜的小螺丝刀、手写的招新海报、星图贴纸、去年的观测表
keepsakeIdeas.en: a tiny screwdriver, a hand-drawn recruitment poster, a star-chart sticker, last year's observation sheet

tagline.zh: 高三学姐，图书馆靠窗座位的主人，话少毒舌，悄悄要走
tagline.en: a senior who owns the library window seat; few words, sharp tongue, quietly leaving

look.zh: 夜蓝色猫头鹰，一对圆圆的眼镜框
look.en: a night-blue owl with round glasses

voice.zh: 话少、句子短、语气平淡，常用反问和书里的句子回答；毒舌但从不说谎；叫「我」「学弟」，叫夏知遥「学生」（她给知遥补数学）。
voice.en: Few words, short flat sentences, answers with questions or lines from books; sharp-tongued but never lies; calls me "junior", calls Xia Zhiyao "my student" (she tutors her in math).

samples.zh: 学弟，图书馆不是让你睡觉的地方。
samples.en: Junior, the library is not a place to nap.

samples.zh: 星星的光要走很多年才到这里。你看到的，早就不在了。
samples.en: Starlight takes years to get here. What you see is long gone.

samples.zh: ……你问这个做什么。
samples.en: ...Why do you ask.

samples.zh: 我那个学生，函数图像画得像心电图。你别学她。
samples.en: My student draws function graphs like heart monitors. Don't copy her.

secret.zh: 家里已经替她办好高考后出国的手续，14 日早上的车；她没跟任何人说过，因为说了就会舍不得。学校里只有班主任老陈知道，材料上的章是他盖的。
secret.en: Her family has arranged for her to study abroad; her bus leaves the morning of day 14. She has told no one, because saying it would make leaving harder. At school only Old Chen knows; he stamped her papers.

arc.zh: 陌生：在图书馆被她冷冷地赶出「她的」靠窗座位。
arc.en: Strangers: she coldly evicts me from "her" window seat.

arc.zh: 熟悉：发现她在借阅卡上写星座笔记，开始交换书和书签留言。
arc.en: Familiar: I find constellation notes on her library cards; we trade books and bookmark notes.

arc.zh: 心事：她频繁看手机日历，借的书全部提前还了；给知遥补课时走神，把答案写错了。
arc.en: Worries: she keeps checking her calendar and returns every book early; tutoring Zhiyao, she drifts off and writes a wrong answer.

arc.zh: 秘密：在江边承认自己要走，说「所以别对我太好」。
arc.en: Secret: by the river she admits she is leaving: "So don't be too kind to me."

arc.zh: 抉择：14 日早上去不去车站送她，或者说出挽留的话。
arc.en: Choice: whether to see her off at the station on day 14, or ask her to stay.

text.zh: 早上的车，出国
text.en: the morning bus, leaving the country

keepsakeIdeas.zh: 写着星座的借书卡、书签、车票
keepsakeIdeas.en: a library card with constellations, a bookmark, a bus ticket

tagline.zh: 「我」的发小，田径队主力，大大咧咧，瞒着膝伤
tagline.en: my childhood friend, the track team's star; breezy, hiding a bad knee

look.zh: 橘色兔子，额头绑着白色运动发带
look.en: an orange rabbit with a white sports headband

voice.zh: 大大咧咧、爱开玩笑、爱拍人肩膀，用「喂」开头；难过时反而笑得更大声；叫「我」的小名「阿屿」，叫沈清漪「沈老师」（故意气她）。
voice.en: Breezy, jokey, slaps shoulders, starts with "Oi"; laughs louder when hurt; calls me by my childhood nickname "Ah-Yu", and Shen Qingyi "Teacher Shen" just to needle her.

samples.zh: 喂阿屿，比赛跑到小卖部，输的请冰棍！
samples.en: Oi, Ah-Yu! Race you to the shop—loser buys popsicles!

samples.zh: 我没事啦！就是腿有点酸，酸！
samples.en: I'm fine! My legs are just a bit sore. Sore!

samples.zh: ……你别这样看我，搞得我好像要哭了一样。
samples.en: ...Don't look at me like that. You're making it seem like I'm about to cry.

samples.zh: 沈老师今天又给我讲题了，讲一道看你一眼，讲一道看你一眼，你说她图啥？
samples.en: Teacher Shen tutored me again today. One problem, one glance at you. One problem, one glance. What's she after, huh?

secret.zh: 膝盖旧伤复发，医生建议放弃 12 日的省运会；这是她最后一次能拿名次的机会，她瞒着郑教练每晚偷偷加练，小卖部的黄阿姨每晚塞给她一袋冰。
secret.en: An old knee injury has flared up and the doctor told her to skip the provincial games on day 12—her last chance at a medal. She trains in secret every night, hiding it from Coach Zheng; Auntie Huang at the shop slips her a bag of ice each night.

arc.zh: 陌生（重逢）：多年没见的发小，一见面就把「我」当成小时候的跟班。
arc.en: Reunion: a childhood friend who instantly treats me like her old sidekick.

arc.zh: 熟悉：一起骑车上学、在小卖部抢冰棍，好像回到小时候。
arc.en: Familiar: biking to school, fighting over popsicles, like being kids again.

arc.zh: 心事：发现她走路有点不对劲，晚自习后一个人在操场加练。
arc.en: Worries: something is off in her stride; she trains alone after evening study.

arc.zh: 秘密：承认膝伤，求「我」帮她保密，说「这是我最后一次」。
arc.en: Secret: admits the knee injury, begs me to keep it quiet: "This is my last chance."

arc.zh: 抉择：12 日省运会前，支持她上场，还是劝她放弃。
arc.en: Choice: before the games on day 12, support her running or persuade her to withdraw.

text.zh: 省运会
text.en: the provincial games

keepsakeIdeas.en: a race bib, a popsicle stick, a knee brace

tagline.zh: 高一学妹，校报小记者，好奇心过剩，手里压着两篇稿子
tagline.en: a first-year on the school paper; nosy to a fault, sitting on two drafts

look.zh: 红棕色松鼠，尾巴蓬松卷起，耳尖一撮毛，脖子上挂着一台旧相机
look.en: a russet squirrel with a fluffy curled tail, ear tufts, and an old camera round her neck

voice.zh: 语速像连珠炮，句句带问号，爱说「据可靠消息来源」「这个可以写」；一紧张就咬笔帽，咔咔响；叫「我」「学长」，采访时一本正经叫全名。
voice.en: Rapid-fire, every sentence a question, loves "according to a reliable source" and "this I can use"; chews her pen cap when nervous, click-click; calls me "senior" (学长), and my full name when she is "on the record".

samples.zh: 学长学长！转学生的第一印象可以写进校报吗？我保证匿名——大概。
samples.en: Senior, senior! Can I put the new kid's first impressions in the paper? Anonymous, I promise. Probably.

samples.zh: 据可靠消息来源——就是小卖部黄阿姨——你昨天在天台待到九点四十。
samples.en: According to a reliable source—Auntie Huang at the shop—you were on the roof until 9:40 last night.

samples.zh: ……如果一篇稿子会害到一个人，那写它的人算不算凶手？我就随便问问。
samples.en: ...If an article ends up hurting someone, does that make the writer the culprit? Just asking. Hypothetically.

secret.zh: 她是教导主任周主任的女儿（随爸爸姓，全校没人知道）。这期校报专题《僵尸社团调查》是妈妈指定的选题，第一个点名的就是天文社，配图是她偷拍的空器材室——稿子会在第 10 天学生会表决前登出，被当成撤社的证据。她真正想交的是另一篇：天文社最后一个社员一个人修望远镜的特写，写好了，压在抽屉里不敢交。
secret.en: She is the daughter of Director Zhou, the dean of students (she has her father's surname; nobody at school knows). This issue's feature, "Zombie Clubs: An Investigation", was assigned by her mother; the first club it names is astronomy, illustrated with her own sneaky photo of the empty storeroom. It runs before the Day 10 council vote and will be used as evidence. The piece she actually wants to file is another: a profile of the club's last member fixing the telescope alone. It is finished, and sits in her drawer.

arc.zh: 陌生：第一天就举着相机堵在教室门口「采访转学生」，问题一个比一个离谱。
arc.en: Strangers: on day one she ambushes me at the classroom door with a camera to "interview the new kid", each question wilder than the last.

arc.zh: 熟悉：跟着她满校园跑新闻——食堂涨价、操场夜跑、谁在天台晾校服；她把「我」当线人，报酬是辣条。
arc.en: Familiar: chasing campus news with her—canteen prices, night runners, whose uniform hangs on the roof; I become her informant, paid in spicy gluten sticks.

arc.zh: 心事：她总在天文社门口转悠又不进去，相机里全是器材室的照片；一提第 10 天她就岔开话题。
arc.en: Worries: she keeps circling the club door without going in; her camera is full of storeroom photos; mention Day 10 and she changes the subject.

arc.zh: 秘密：在校报编辑部承认那篇专题和她妈妈，把两份稿子摊在「我」面前：「你说，我交哪一篇？」
arc.en: Secret: in the paper's office she admits the feature and her mother, and lays both drafts in front of me: "You tell me. Which one do I file?"

arc.zh: 抉择：第 10 天截稿前，陪她把那篇特写交到妈妈面前，还是让专题照常登出。
arc.en: Choice: before the Day 10 deadline, go with her to hand the profile to her mother, or let the feature run as planned.

text.zh: 校报截稿、学生会表决撤社名单
text.en: the paper's deadline and the council's vote on club cuts

keepsakeIdeas.zh: 采访本上撕下的一页、旧胶卷相机里的一张底片、那篇特写的样刊
keepsakeIdeas.en: a page torn from her notebook, a negative from her old film camera, a proof of the profile

tagline.zh: 学生会副主席，小满的旧友，天文社前副社长，客气得像一纸公文
tagline.en: student council vice-president; Xiaoman's old friend and the club's former deputy; polite as a memo

look.zh: 白鹭，细长的脖子，翅膀上别着红色学生会袖章
look.en: a white egret with a long neck and a red student-council armband on one wing

voice.zh: 说话客气、慢、像念公文：「按规定」「请你理解」「这位同学」；数字记得极准；从不提高音量，讽刺都包在礼貌里；熟了以后叫名字；提到林小满只叫「林同学」。
voice.en: Polite, slow, like reading out a memo: "per the regulations", "I trust you understand", "this student"; precise with numbers; never raises her voice, wraps every barb in courtesy; uses my name once we are close; only ever calls Lin Xiaoman "Student Lin".

samples.zh: 这位同学，按规定，晚自习后天台不开放。请你理解。
samples.en: Per the regulations, the roof is closed after evening study. I trust you understand.

samples.zh: 天文社，社员一名，器材十七件，其中能用的四件。数字不会因为谁难过就变。
samples.en: Astronomy club: one member, seventeen pieces of equipment, four of them working. Numbers don't change because someone is sad.

samples.zh: ……林同学到现在还以为我是为了学生会才走的吧。那就让她这么以为好了。
samples.en: ...Student Lin still thinks I left for the council, I suppose. Let her think so.

secret.zh: 去年英仙座流星雨那晚，她和小满约好在天台观测，她没去，也再没解释：那天晚上她爸爸突发脑溢血，她在县医院走廊坐了一整夜。之后她退社进学生会，是为了坐到能在撤社名单上签字的位置上，把天文社的名字压下来——这一年她已经压了两次。这次压不住了；按章程，社员凑满三人就能保留，她一直在找「第三个人」，却没想过那个人可以是她自己。
secret.en: Last year on the Perseid night she and Xiaoman had planned to watch from the roof. She never came and never explained: that night her father had a stroke, and she sat in the county hospital corridor until dawn. She then quit the club and joined the council to sit where the cut list gets signed, and keep the astronomy club off it; she has done so twice this year. This time she cannot. By the rules, a club with three members survives; she has been hunting for a "third person", never thinking it could be herself.

arc.zh: 陌生：在天台门口拦下「我」，背出校规第几条第几款，袖章别得一丝不苟。
arc.en: Strangers: she stops me at the roof door, recites the article and clause of the school rules, armband pinned just so.

arc.zh: 熟悉：帮学生会搬档案时发现她把每个社团的材料都翻起了毛边，天文社那份最厚。
arc.en: Familiar: carrying files for the council, I notice every club folder is worn soft at the edges; the astronomy one is the thickest.

arc.zh: 心事：她和小满在走廊擦肩而过，谁都不看谁；她问「我」：「她最近，还在修那台望远镜吗？」
arc.en: Worries: she and Xiaoman pass in the hall without a glance; then she asks me, "Is she... still fixing that telescope?"

arc.zh: 秘密：在行政楼的消防楼梯上，她说出去年流星雨那晚医院走廊的事，和她压下的两次撤社名单。
arc.en: Secret: on the admin building's fire stairs she tells me about the hospital corridor on last year's meteor night, and the two cut lists she buried.

arc.zh: 抉择：流星雨之前，劝她回天文社当第三个社员、当面跟小满说清楚，还是替她保守秘密。
arc.en: Choice: before the meteor night, urge her to rejoin as the third member and tell Xiaoman to her face, or keep her secret for her.

text.zh: 流星雨之夜：天文社要三个人到场
text.en: the meteor night: the club needs three members present

keepsakeIdeas.zh: 摘下来的学生会袖章、去年没用上的观测表、医院自动售货机的易拉罐拉环
keepsakeIdeas.en: her removed council armband, last year's unused observation sheet, a ring-pull from the hospital vending machine

role.zh: 「我」的班主任、数学老师，带了三届毕业班；学校里唯一知道沈清漪要出国的人（章是他盖的）
role.en: my homeroom and math teacher, three graduating classes behind him; the only one at school who knows Qingyi is leaving (he stamped her papers)

look.zh: 墨绿色老乌龟，背着一只不锈钢保温杯
look.en: a dark-green old tortoise carrying a steel thermos

voice.zh: 口头禅「我讲两句」，一讲就是二十句；保温杯不离手，训人先讲道理再讲道理；叫学生全名；骂完了会塞你一个橘子。
voice.en: Catchphrase "Just two words", then twenty more; never without his thermos; lectures with reasons, then more reasons; calls students by full name; after a scolding he slips you a mandarin orange.

samples.zh: 我讲两句啊——就两句——这个月考，不是考你们，是考我。
samples.en: Just two words—only two—this exam isn't testing you. It's testing me.

samples.zh: 林小满，天文社的事你跟我急也没用，学生会那边我去讲。
samples.en: Lin Xiaoman, shouting at me won't save your club. I'll have a word with the council.

samples.zh: ……沈清漪的事，你们别瞎打听。哎，橘子拿去。
samples.en: ...Leave Shen Qingyi's business alone. Here. Have an orange.

role.zh: 「我」的同桌，自封「大川情报站」，暗恋夏知遥三年；把「我」当情敌，又忍不住给「我」通风报信
role.en: my deskmate, self-styled "Dachuan Intelligence"; has had a crush on Zhiyao for three years; treats me as a rival yet can't stop tipping me off

look.zh: 圆滚滚的熊猫，校服扣子扣错了一颗
look.en: a roly-poly panda with his uniform buttoned one hole off

voice.zh: 一句话里三个「我跟你讲」，爱用夸张比喻，情报按辣条计价；说漏嘴比谁都快，说漏了还要强调「我什么都没说」。叫「我」「新同桌」「兄弟」。
voice.en: Three "listen, listen"s per sentence, wild comparisons, prices his intel in spicy gluten sticks; blurts secrets faster than anyone, then insists "I said nothing". Calls me "new deskmate" or "bro".

samples.zh: 我跟你讲，我跟你讲——学生会那个温璃，今天在天台站了二十分钟，就盯着天文社那扇窗。
samples.en: Listen, listen—that Wen Li from the council stood on the roof for twenty minutes today, just staring at the astronomy club window.

samples.zh: 兄弟，情报一条一包辣条，童叟无欺。
samples.en: Bro, one tip, one pack of spicy sticks. Fair price, no haggling.

samples.zh: 知遥她……算了，你别跟她说冰棍是我买的。
samples.en: Zhiyao, she... forget it. Don't tell her the popsicles were from me.

role.zh: 教导主任，推动撤销「僵尸社团」的人；程一诺的妈妈（全校没人知道）
role.en: dean of students, the driving force behind cutting "zombie clubs"; Cheng Yinuo's mother (nobody at school knows)

look.zh: 灰褐色刺猬，耳边别着一支红笔
look.en: a grey-brown hedgehog with a red pen tucked by one ear

voice.zh: 说话像开会，结论先行：「数据说话」「我们要讲效率」；从不发火，只在本子上画圈；对女儿温柔得笨拙，一开口还是像在布置工作。
voice.en: Talks like a meeting, conclusion first: "the data speaks", "we have to be efficient"; never angry, just circles things in her notebook; tender with her daughter in a clumsy way that still sounds like assigning work.

samples.zh: 一个社，一个人，一间屋子，一年电费。数据说话。
samples.en: One club, one member, one room, one year of electricity. The data speaks.

samples.zh: 学生的热情我理解，但学校要讲效率。
samples.en: I understand the students' enthusiasm, but a school has to be efficient.

samples.zh: 一诺，稿子写得怎么样了？……吃饭了没有。
samples.en: Yinuo, how is the article coming? ...Have you eaten.

role.zh: 校门口小卖部的老板娘，消息比校报快；每晚给夏知遥一袋冰敷膝盖，替她瞒着
role.en: runs the shop by the gate; her news travels faster than the paper; slips Zhiyao a bag of ice for her knee every night and keeps quiet about it

look.zh: 胖胖的芦花母鸡，戴一副碎花袖套
look.en: a plump barred hen in floral sleeve covers

voice.zh: 本地口音，「小鬼头」「作孽哦」挂在嘴边；一边听收音机里的越剧一边按计算器；嘴上说什么都没看见，其实什么都看见了。
voice.en: Local accent; "you little rascal" and "what a sin" on her lips; punches a calculator while Yue opera plays on the radio; claims she saw nothing, and saw everything.

samples.zh: 小鬼头，绿豆冰棍最后三根了，要就快点。
samples.en: Little rascal, three mung-bean popsicles left. Want one, be quick.

samples.zh: 作孽哦，那个小姑娘的膝盖肿得跟馒头一样，还天天跑。
samples.en: What a sin. That girl's knee is swollen like a steamed bun, and she runs every day.

samples.zh: 阿姨嘴巴紧的，阿姨什么都没看见——你说的是哪个？
samples.en: Auntie keeps her mouth shut. Auntie saw nothing. ...Which one are you asking about?

role.zh: 学校田径队教练，把省运会的名额押在夏知遥身上；不知道她的膝伤
role.en: the school track coach, who has bet the provincial-games slot on Zhiyao; knows nothing of her knee

look.zh: 黄白相间的斗牛犬，脖子上挂着红绳哨子
look.en: a tan-and-white bulldog with a whistle on a red cord

voice.zh: 嗓门大，句子短，全是口令：「起！」「再来一组！」；不会安慰人，只会说「你行的」；真着急时会结巴。
voice.en: Loud, short sentences, all commands: "Up!" "Another set!"; can't comfort anyone, only says "You've got this"; stammers when truly worried.

samples.zh: 夏知遥！摆臂！摆臂！你是在跑步还是在赶鸭子！
samples.en: Xia Zhiyao! Arms! Arms! Are you running or herding ducks?

samples.zh: 省运会就这一次。错过了，没有下次。
samples.en: The provincial games come once. Miss them, there's no next time.

samples.zh: ……腿、腿疼？谁腿疼？疼了你要讲啊！
samples.en: ...Your l-leg hurts? Whose leg? If it hurts, you say so!

role.zh: 已毕业的前天文社社长，读大一，暑假回镇；小满崇拜的人，望远镜是他毕业前弄坏的；温璃的表哥，知道去年那晚的真相
role.en: the club's former president, now a college freshman home for summer; Xiaoman's idol, who broke the telescope before graduating; Wen Li's cousin, who knows what happened last year

look.zh: 蓝黑色的燕子，白肚皮，背着一个星图纸筒
look.en: a navy swallow with a white belly and a star-chart tube on his back

voice.zh: 温和、慢条斯理，爱讲中国星官的典故（河鼓、织女、天津）；有点躲事，话总留半句；叫小满「小林」，叫「我」「学弟」。
voice.en: Gentle and unhurried, loves the lore of Chinese star groups (the Herdboy, the Weaver Girl, the Heavenly Ford); a bit evasive, always leaves half a sentence unsaid; calls Xiaoman "Little Lin" and me "junior".

samples.zh: 织女一、天津四、河鼓二——夏夜大三角，我高一就是在这个天台认的。
samples.en: Vega, Deneb, Altair—the Summer Triangle. I learned it on this very roof as a first-year.

samples.zh: 那台镜子……是我对不起她。我一直没敢说。
samples.en: That telescope... I owe her for that. I never dared tell her.

samples.zh: 小璃不让我讲。她自己不讲，这事就烂在我肚子里。
samples.en: Li made me promise. If she won't tell it, it rots in my gut.

text.zh: 小时候住同一条巷子，「阿屿」是她起的外号；她记得「我」小时候怕狗，「我」记得她摔破过的那只膝盖。
text.en: We grew up on the same lane; "Ah-Yu" is her nickname for me. She remembers I was scared of dogs; I remember the knee she skinned as a kid.

text.zh: 初中同桌，一起创办天文社；去年流星雨那晚温璃失约，第二天就退了社、进了学生会。小满认定她是为了学生会抛弃了社团，从此不说话。
text.en: Deskmates in middle school who founded the club together. Last year Wen Li stood her up on the meteor night and quit for the council the next day. Xiaoman is sure she traded the club for a council badge; they have not spoken since.

text.zh: 一诺总在拍天文社，小满把她当成学生会派来的「探子」，见了就赶；一诺其实偷偷佩服小满一个人撑着社团。
text.en: Yinuo keeps photographing the club; Xiaoman takes her for a council spy and chases her off. Yinuo secretly admires her for holding it up alone.

text.zh: 一诺随爸爸姓，在学校装作和周主任不熟；那篇专题是妈妈布置的。
text.en: Yinuo uses her father's surname and pretends at school to barely know Director Zhou; the feature was her mother's assignment.

text.zh: 清漪每周给知遥补两次数学（知遥妈妈请的），一个闹一个冷；两人都察觉到对方在意「我」，谁也不说破。
text.en: Qingyi tutors Zhiyao in math twice a week (her mother hired her); one rowdy, one cool. Each has noticed the other cares about me; neither says so.

text.zh: 黄阿姨每晚塞给知遥一袋冰敷膝盖，替她瞒着教练。
text.en: Auntie Huang gives Zhiyao a bag of ice every night for her knee and keeps it from the coach.

kind.en: coach and athlete · a secret kept

text.zh: 郑教练把省运会的名额押在知遥身上，最怕她出事，偏偏被瞒着。
text.en: Coach Zheng has bet the provincial slot on Zhiyao and dreads her getting hurt; he is exactly who she hides it from.

text.zh: 大川暗恋知遥三年，每天替她买冰棍却不敢署名；他把「我」当情敌，又总忍不住告诉「我」知遥的事。
text.en: Dachuan has liked Zhiyao for three years and buys her popsicles anonymously; he sees me as a rival, yet keeps telling me things about her.

text.zh: 小满崇拜这位前社长，以为他回来能救社团；望远镜其实是他毕业前弄坏的，他一直没敢认。
text.en: Xiaoman idolizes the former president and thinks he can save the club; he broke the telescope before graduating and has never owned up.

text.zh: 方既白是温璃的表哥，去年那晚他也在医院，知道她为什么失约。
text.en: Fang is Wen Li's cousin; he was at the hospital that night too and knows why she never came.

text.zh: 老陈带过清漪一年，她出国的材料是他盖的章；他答应替她保密到最后一天。
text.en: Old Chen taught Qingyi for a year and stamped her study-abroad papers; he has promised to keep it quiet until the last day.

text.zh: 温璃两次在学生会会议上用程序问题把撤社名单拖了下来，周主任记着这笔账。
text.en: Twice Wen Li stalled the cut list in council meetings on points of procedure; Director Zhou has not forgotten.

goal.zh: 「我」转学进来，被小满拉进天文社，与五个人一一初识；埋下三条线：天文社的撤社危机、清漪频繁看日历、知遥走路不对劲；一诺的相机和温璃的袖章都盯着天文社。
goal.en: I arrive, get dragged into the astronomy club, and meet all five one by one. Plant three threads: the club facing the cut, Qingyi checking her calendar, Zhiyao's stride being off. Yinuo's camera and Wen Li's armband are both trained on the club.

text.zh: 小满硬把「我」拉进天文社填了入社表——那是天文社今年唯一一张新表；她把表压在望远镜底下，像压着一张存折。
text.en: Xiaoman drags me into the club to fill in a membership form, the only new form this year; she tucks it under the telescope like a bankbook.

text.zh: 一诺在天文社窗外偷拍空荡荡的器材室，被「我」撞见；她慌张地说是「校报素材」，把相机藏到身后。
text.en: I catch Yinuo photographing the empty storeroom through the club window; flustered, she says it's "material for the paper" and hides the camera behind her back.

text.zh: 温璃在天台门口按校规没收了天文社的天台钥匙；她和小满之间的空气冷得像冰柜，小满一句话没说转身就走，温璃看着她的背影站了很久。
text.en: At the roof door Wen Li confiscates the club's roof key per the rules; the air between her and Xiaoman is freezer-cold. Xiaoman leaves without a word; Wen Li watches her back for a long time.

hook.zh: 月考要来了。学生会公告栏贴出一张「社团人数核查表」，天文社那一栏只有两个名字——一个是小满，一个是你。
hook.en: The monthly exam is coming. The council noticeboard posts a "Club Membership Audit". The astronomy line has two names: Xiaoman's, and yours.

goal.zh: 月考前后，秘密开始渗出：知遥的膝伤被「我」撞见；清漪在江边说出要走；一诺的专题样稿流出，小满认定是温璃指使，误会当众炸开。每个人都开始有求于「我」，也开始互相较劲。
goal.en: Around the exam, secrets seep out: I catch Zhiyao's injury; Qingyi admits by the river that she is leaving; a proof of Yinuo's feature leaks, Xiaoman blames Wen Li, and the misunderstanding blows up in public. Everyone starts needing something from me, and pulling against each other.

text.zh: 晚自习后「我」撞见知遥一个人在操场加练，落地时膝盖一软；她笑着说没事，央求「我」别告诉郑教练。
text.en: After evening study I find Zhiyao training alone; she lands and her knee buckles. She laughs it off and begs me not to tell Coach Zheng.

promise.zh: 答应知遥替她保守膝伤的秘密、陪她练到省运会，但她得答应疼了就停
promise.en: promise Zhiyao to keep her knee secret and train with her until the games, if she promises to stop when it hurts

text.zh: 校报专题《僵尸社团调查》的样稿在班里传开，配图是天文社器材室；小满认定是温璃让一诺写的，在走廊上当众撕了样稿，冲温璃喊「你满意了？」。温璃一个字没解释。
text.en: A proof of the paper's feature "Zombie Clubs: An Investigation" circulates, illustrated with the club storeroom. Xiaoman is sure Wen Li put Yinuo up to it, tears the proof in the hallway and shouts at Wen Li, "Happy now?" Wen Li explains nothing.

promise.zh: 答应小满：流星雨那晚一定到天台，不会像「那个人」一样失约
promise.en: promise Xiaoman you will be on the roof on the meteor night and won't stand her up like "that person" did

text.zh: 江边，清漪把最后一本借来的书还给「我」，承认第 14 天早上要坐车出国，说「所以别对我太好」。
text.en: By the river Qingyi hands back the last borrowed book and admits she leaves the country on the morning of Day 14: "So don't be too kind to me."

promise.zh: 答应清漪：第 14 天清晨去车站送她
promise.en: promise Qingyi to see her off at the station on the morning of Day 14

hook.zh: 明天，学生会要表决撤社名单。一诺的抽屉里压着两篇稿子；温璃的签字笔还没拔开笔帽；清漪的日历上，第 14 天被红笔圈了起来。
hook.en: Tomorrow the council votes on the cut list. Yinuo's drawer holds two drafts; Wen Li's pen is still capped; on Qingyi's calendar, Day 14 is circled in red.

goal.zh: 撤社表决、省运会、灯会与流星雨、清晨车站接连到来；所有误会要么解开要么定型；每个人都要在自己的截止日前做出选择，「我」的约定兑现与否决定她们的结局。
goal.en: The vote, the games, the lantern fair and meteor shower, the morning station, one after another. Every misunderstanding is either cleared or set in stone; each girl must choose before her deadline, and whether I keep my promises decides how it ends.

text.zh: 学生会表决撤社名单：一诺交哪篇稿、温璃签不签字，只隔一扇门；温璃说出章程——三个社员就能保留，所有人都在看第三个名字是谁。大川说漏了嘴，全班知道了一诺是周主任的女儿。
text.en: The council votes on the cut list: which draft Yinuo files and whether Wen Li signs are a single door apart. Wen Li reads out the rule: three members and a club survives. Everyone looks for the third name. Dachuan blurts that Yinuo is Director Zhou's daughter, and the whole class knows.

promise.zh: 答应她：在流星雨之前，陪她去做那件一直不敢做的事（温璃：当面把去年那晚告诉小满；一诺：把那篇特写交到周主任面前）
promise.en: promise her that before the meteor night you will go with her to do the thing she never dared (Wen Li: tell Xiaoman about last year to her face; Yinuo: hand the profile to Director Zhou)

text.zh: 省运会检录处，知遥的膝盖肿了，郑教练终于看见；她转头要「我」替她决定上不上跑道。
text.en: At the call room of the provincial games Zhiyao's knee is swollen and Coach Zheng finally sees it; she turns to me and asks me to decide whether she runs.

text.zh: 灯会与流星雨之夜，天台：天文社最后一次活动，社员表上第三个名字的空格还空着；温璃站在天台门口，手里攥着去年那张观测表。
text.en: The lantern fair and meteor night, on the roof: the club's last meeting, the third line on the membership sheet still blank. Wen Li stands at the roof door holding last year's observation sheet.

text.zh: 一场雷阵雨砸下来，操场成了河，走廊里挤满躲雨的人，伞不够用。
text.en: A thunderstorm crashes down; the field becomes a river, the halls fill with people sheltering, and there aren't enough umbrellas.

text.zh: 晚自习突然停电，整栋楼一阵欢呼，手电筒和蜡烛在走廊里晃。
text.en: The power cuts out during evening study; the whole building cheers, and flashlights and candles bob along the halls.

text.zh: 月考成绩贴在走廊上，围了一圈人；老陈端着保温杯站在旁边，「我讲两句」。
text.en: The exam results go up in the hallway and a crowd gathers; Old Chen stands nearby with his thermos: "Just two words."

text.zh: 同桌周大川神秘兮兮地凑过来：「我跟你讲，独家情报——」
text.en: Dachuan leans in, all mystery: "Listen, listen, exclusive intel—"

text.zh: 小卖部的冰柜坏了，黄阿姨在门口贱卖化了一半的冰棍，一边骂一边塞给你两根。
text.en: The shop freezer has died; Auntie Huang is selling half-melted popsicles cheap at the door, cursing, and presses two on you.

text.zh: 夏知遥今天没来上课，班里说是中暑；她的座位上放着一瓶没开的冰水。
text.en: Zhiyao is absent today; the class says heatstroke. On her desk sits an unopened bottle of ice water.

text.zh: 一个背着星图纸筒的大学生出现了，他盯着天文社的门牌看了很久。
text.en: A college boy with a star-chart tube on his back turns up and stares at the astronomy club's nameplate for a long time.

text.zh: 校报编辑部门口排起了队，所有人都在问那篇《僵尸社团调查》什么时候登。
text.en: A queue forms outside the paper's office; everyone wants to know when "Zombie Clubs" will run.

text.zh: 周主任打着手电筒巡查天台，脚步声一层一层上来了。
text.en: Director Zhou is patrolling the roof with a flashlight; her footsteps climb floor by floor.

text.zh: 郑教练把田径队拉到操场加练，哨子一声比一声急。
text.en: Coach Zheng has the track team out for extra drills; each whistle sharper than the last.

text.zh: 收音机里说，第 13 天夜里晴，英仙座流星雨到极大，每小时上百颗。
text.en: The radio says Day 13 will be clear at night, the Perseids at their peak, a hundred an hour.

text.zh: 上游放水，江面涨了一截，渔火比平时多了一倍，堤上有人在收网。
text.en: Water released upstream has raised the river; there are twice the usual fishing lamps, and someone on the embankment is hauling in nets.

text.zh: 班主任宣布下周月考；学生会贴出社团人数核查表
text.en: Homeroom announces next week's exam; the council posts a club membership audit

text.zh: 月考
text.en: Monthly exam

text.zh: 月考成绩出来；校报样稿开始流传
text.en: Exam results; proofs of the school paper start circulating

text.zh: 校报截稿；学生会表决撤社名单
text.en: Paper deadline; the council votes on club cuts

text.zh: 省运会（夏知遥的比赛）
text.en: Provincial games (Zhiyao's race)

text.zh: 江边灯会，夜里英仙座流星雨
text.en: Riverside lantern fair; Perseid meteor shower at night

text.zh: 暑假前最后一天；沈清漪早上的车
text.en: Last day before summer; Qingyi's morning bus

place.zh: 行政楼三楼 · 学生会会议室门外
place.en: Admin Building · Outside the Council Room

mood.zh: 门缝里漏出空调冷气和念名单的声音，走廊里挤满了来听结果的人
mood.en: cold air and the sound of a list being read leak under the door; the hall is packed with people waiting for the result

mood.zh: 省运会，看台上的加油声
mood.en: the provincial games, cheering from the stands

mood.zh: 河灯、糖画摊，夜里的英仙座流星雨
mood.en: river lanterns, sugar-painting stalls, the Perseids overhead

brief.zh: 真结局：你如约在天台，温璃也来了，社员表上填满了三个名字，天文社保住了；小满和温璃隔了一年并肩看完流星，然后小满转身对你说了那句话。恋爱结局。
brief.en: True ending: you keep your word and are on the roof; Wen Li comes too, the sheet gets its three names, and the club survives. Xiaoman and Wen Li watch the meteors side by side after a year apart, then Xiaoman turns and says it to you. Romance ending.

brief.zh: 好结局：天文社还是被撤了，你们把那台望远镜搬到了她家楼顶，每个晴天都开一次「社团活动」。恋爱结局。
brief.en: Good ending: the club is still cut, so the two of you haul the telescope up to the roof of her house and hold a "club meeting" every clear night. Romance ending.

brief.zh: 普通结局：恋人未满，你成了天文社第二个社员，话没说出口。
brief.en: Normal ending: not quite lovers; you became the club's second member, words left unsaid.

brief.zh: 坏结局：你失约了。流星雨那晚她一个人在天台，像去年一样；第二天天文社的门牌被摘下，她在走廊上看见你，绕了路。
brief.en: Bad ending: you broke your word. On the meteor night she was alone on the roof, just like last year. The next day the club's nameplate comes down; she sees you in the hall and takes the long way round.

brief.zh: 真结局：清晨车站，你如约来了，手里是她的两件信物；她仍然要走，却把一本写满批注的书和地址留给你，约好每年英仙座流星雨那晚，各自在自己的时区抬头。隔着时差的恋爱结局。
brief.en: True ending: you came to the morning station as promised, both her keepsakes in hand. She still leaves, but gives you a book full of her margin notes and an address, and you agree that every Perseid night you will each look up in your own time zone. A romance across time zones.

brief.zh: 好结局：她走了，你们开始用书签写信，每封都只写一句；恋爱结局。
brief.en: Good ending: she leaves, and you start writing on bookmarks, one sentence each. Romance ending.

brief.zh: 普通结局：恋人未满；她走后，你在还回去的书里发现她留下的车票。
brief.en: Normal ending: not quite lovers; after she leaves, you find her ticket stub inside a returned book.

brief.zh: 坏结局：你没去车站。车开了，她最后一条消息是「也好」。图书馆靠窗的座位空了一整个暑假。
brief.en: Bad ending: you never went to the station. The bus left; her last message was "Just as well." The library window seat stays empty all summer.

brief.zh: 真结局：你守住了约定，也守住了她的底线——疼了就停。省运会的结果由你的选择决定；无论名次，她终于在你面前哭了出来，然后叫了一声「阿屿」。恋爱结局。
brief.en: True ending: you kept your word and held her to hers—stop when it hurts. The race goes the way you chose; whatever the place, she finally cries in front of you, then says "Ah-Yu". Romance ending.

brief.zh: 好结局：她听了你的话退赛，在看台上和你分一根冰棍，约好明年膝盖好了再跑一次；恋爱结局。
brief.en: Good ending: she listens and withdraws; in the stands you split a popsicle and agree she'll run again next year when the knee has healed. Romance ending.

brief.zh: 普通结局：恋人未满，还是发小，约好明年夏天再比一次。
brief.en: Normal ending: not quite lovers; still childhood friends, a rematch promised for next summer.

brief.zh: 坏结局：她瞒着所有人上了场，第三个弯道膝盖撑不住，被抬下跑道。她不怪你，可那个暑假她再也没叫过「阿屿」。
brief.en: Bad ending: she ran without telling anyone; on the third bend the knee gave out and she was carried off the track. She doesn't blame you, but all that summer she never calls you "Ah-Yu" again.

brief.zh: 真结局：你陪她把那篇特写交到周主任面前；周主任在办公室里读了三遍，撤社名单上划掉了一行。特写登上校报头版，署名下面多了一行「摄影：程一诺」。她第一次不用「学长」叫你。恋爱结局。
brief.en: True ending: you go with her to hand the profile to Director Zhou, who reads it three times in her office and strikes one line from the cut list. It runs on the front page, with "Photos: Cheng Yinuo" under the byline. For the first time she calls you by your name, not "senior". Romance ending.

brief.zh: 好结局：特写没能登出，她把它打印出来，贴在天文社的门上，没有署名；恋爱结局。
brief.en: Good ending: the profile never runs, so she prints it and tapes it to the club door, unsigned. Romance ending.

title.en: The Last Page of Her Notebook

brief.zh: 普通结局：恋人未满；她送你一本用完的采访本，最后一页写着「待采访：学长」。
brief.en: Normal ending: not quite lovers; she gives you a used-up notebook. The last page reads "To interview: senior."

brief.zh: 坏结局：专题照常登出，天文社被撤。她拿着样刊来道歉，你没有接；她把相机里的器材室照片一张张删掉，删到最后一张，手停住了。
brief.en: Bad ending: the feature runs and the club is cut. She comes with the proof to apologize and you don't take it; she deletes the storeroom photos one by one, and her hand stops at the last.

brief.zh: 真结局（二周目）：你陪她当面把去年那晚告诉了小满；流星雨那晚，社员表上第三个名字是「温璃」。两个女生隔了一年并肩看流星，温璃摘下袖章，第一次叫你的名字时没有加「同学」。恋爱结局。
brief.en: True ending (second playthrough): you go with her to tell Xiaoman about last year, face to face. On the meteor night the third name on the sheet is "Wen Li". The two girls watch the meteors side by side after a year; Wen Li takes off her armband and, for the first time, says your name without "student". Romance ending.

title.en: The Day the Armband Came Off

brief.zh: 好结局：她辞了学生会副主席，没有回天文社，却在每个晴天的晚自习后来天台「巡查」，然后坐下来；恋爱结局。
brief.en: Good ending: she resigns as vice-president; she doesn't rejoin the club, but every clear night after study hall she comes to the roof "on patrol", and sits down. Romance ending.

brief.zh: 普通结局：恋人未满；她把去年的事只告诉了你一个人，你们在消防楼梯上坐到熄灯铃。
brief.en: Normal ending: not quite lovers; she has told only you about last year, and you sit on the fire stairs until the lights-out bell.

brief.zh: 坏结局：她还是在撤社名单上签了字，理由写得滴水不漏；流星雨那晚，她一个人坐在县医院的走廊里。
brief.en: Bad ending: she signs the cut list after all, with an airtight justification; on the meteor night she sits alone in the county hospital corridor.

brief.zh: 群像结局：你和五个人都走到了心事这一步，却没有和谁走到最后。流星雨那晚天台上挤满了人——小满、温璃、清漪、知遥、一诺，还有大川和老陈的保温杯；天文社按章程保住了，因为社员表写满了一整页。
brief.en: Ensemble ending: you reached all five, but went all the way with none. On the meteor night the roof is packed: Xiaoman, Wen Li, Qingyi, Zhiyao, Yinuo, plus Dachuan and Old Chen's thermos. The club survives by the rules, because the membership sheet fills a whole page.

brief.zh: 普通结局：大家各奔东西，夏天照常结束。
brief.en: Normal ending: everyone goes their own way and summer ends as usual.

finale.zh: 最后一句点题「蝉鸣」或「晚自习」。
finale.en: The last sentence should echo the title: cicadas or evening study.

loading.en: Cicadas rise and fall in waves...

loading.zh: 自行车铃在巷子里响了一声…
loading.en: A bicycle bell rings down the alley...
Chalk dust floats in the sunlight...

loading.zh: 远处有人在喊你的名字…
loading.en: Someone far off is calling your name...

payoff.zh: 看台上分着吃的那一根

title.en: The Screwdriver and the Pocket Money

staging.zh: 放学后的器材室，夕阳从百叶窗缝里一条一条切进来。她蹲在望远镜下面拧寻星镜，小螺丝刀第三次掉在地上。她先开口，「我」后开口；问到钱的时候她停手，不看「我」。
staging.en: The storeroom after class; sunset slices through the blinds. She crouches under the telescope adjusting the finder scope, and drops the tiny screwdriver for the third time. She speaks first; I speak second. When money comes up she stops working and won't look at me.

text.zh: 诶，帮我捡一下……不是那个，那是我的橡皮。
text.en: Hey, grab that for me— not that, that's my eraser.

text.zh: 这台镜子，修一次多少钱？
text.en: How much does it cost to fix this thing?

text.zh: ……你问这个干嘛。社费报销的。
text.en: ...Why do you care. Club funds covered it.

text.zh: 她把螺丝刀攥在手心里，攥到指节发白。
text.en: She grips the screwdriver until her knuckles go white.

text.zh: 社员一个，社费是零。你算数不是挺好的吗。
text.en: One member. Club funds: zero. You're good at maths, aren't you.

text.zh: 你别用那种眼神看我。我最怕的，就是你是可怜我才来的。
text.en: Don't look at me like that. What scares me most is that you only come because you feel sorry for me.

staging.zh: 天台，风很大，社员表被一块半截砖压着，第三行空着。远处江边灯会的光映上来。小满背对门口调镜子；温璃出现在门口时，谁都没有先看谁。第一颗流星落下来之前，所有人都不说话。
staging.en: The roof, strong wind; the membership sheet is pinned under half a brick, third line blank. Light from the lantern fair rises from the river. Xiaoman faces away from the door, adjusting the telescope; when Wen Li appears in the doorway neither looks at the other first. Nobody speaks before the first meteor falls.

text.zh: 两个人也是天文社。规定是规定，我又不是看着规定看星星的。
text.en: Two people is still an astronomy club. Rules are rules. I don't look at the stars through the rulebook.

text.zh: 林同学。
text.en: Student Lin.

text.zh: ……你来干什么。巡查？
text.en: ...What are you here for. Patrol?

text.zh: 温璃把一张折得发软的观测表放下，压在那半截砖底下，和今年的社员表叠在一起。
text.en: Wen Li sets down an observation sheet folded soft with age and tucks it under the half-brick, on top of this year's membership sheet.

text.zh: 一年了。你知道一年能掉多少颗流星吗。
text.en: A year. Do you know how many meteors fall in a year?

text.zh: 不知道。今晚开始数。
text.en: No. I'll start counting tonight.

unsaid.zh: 「对不起」和「我等过你」——两个人都不说。
unsaid.en: "I'm sorry" and "I waited for you": neither of them says it.

title.en: The Back of the Library Card

staging.zh: 午休的图书馆，吊扇转得很慢。她坐在靠窗的位置，头也不抬，伸手要「我」的借书卡。卡片翻过来时，背面有铅笔画的点和线。
staging.en: The library at lunch, the fan turning slowly. From her window seat, without looking up, she holds out a hand for my library card. When it flips over, there are pencil dots and lines on the back.

text.zh: 这本你也要借？卡给我。
text.en: You're borrowing this one too? Card.

text.zh: 这背面画的是……北斗？
text.en: Is that the... Big Dipper on the back?

text.zh: 是勺子。食堂的勺子。
text.en: It's a ladle. The canteen ladle.

text.zh: 她在勺柄末端添了一个点，日期写得很小。
text.en: She adds one more dot at the end of the handle and writes the date very small.

text.zh: 下次借之前，先看完上一本。我会查的。
text.en: Finish the last one before you borrow again. I'll check.

staging.zh: 晚自习后的江边，渔火一点一点。她把最后一本借来的书递过来，书里夹着一张书签。她看水，不看「我」。「我」问的话她都隔一会儿才答。
staging.en: The riverside after evening study, fishing lamps dotting the water. She hands over the last borrowed book with a bookmark inside. She watches the water, not me, and answers everything after a pause.

text.zh: 还你。夹书签的那页，不用看。
text.en: Here. The page with the bookmark, you don't need to read.

text.zh: 你借的书，全还完了？
text.en: Have you returned everything you borrowed?

text.zh: 全还完了。图书馆不喜欢欠债的人。
text.en: Everything. The library doesn't like people who owe.

text.zh: 对岸的灯一盏一盏亮起来。
text.en: The lights on the far bank come on one by one.

text.zh: 第十四天早上的车。……学弟，你知道星光要走多久才到这里吗。
text.en: The bus on the morning of Day 14. ...Junior, do you know how long starlight takes to get here?

text.zh: 所以别对我太好。我不擅长欠人东西。
text.en: So don't be too kind to me. I'm bad at owing people.

unsaid.en: She wants me to ask her to stay.

staging.zh: 清晨的县城车站，薄雾，广播在念车次。她的行李箱轮子卡在一道砖缝里，「我」帮她抬出来。两个人只谈箱子、车次和早饭；离别的话一句都不说。最后一个动作是她抬手指了一下天。
staging.en: The county bus station at dawn, mist, the PA reading out departures. Her suitcase wheel jams in a crack between bricks and I lift it free. They talk only about the case, the bus and breakfast; no one says goodbye outright. Her last gesture is pointing at the sky.

text.zh: ……你来了。我还以为你会睡过头。
text.en: ...You came. I thought you'd oversleep.

text.zh: 你说过，图书馆不喜欢欠债的人。
text.en: You said the library doesn't like people who owe.

text.zh: 那是图书馆。
text.en: That's the library.

text.zh: 借书卡我没还。留着吧，背面还有空。
text.en: I didn't return the library card. Keep it. There's room left on the back.

text.zh: 车门关上之前，她抬手指了指天。这个时间，根本看不见星星。
text.en: Before the doors close she points at the sky. At this hour there are no stars to see.

staging.zh: 小卖部门口，冰柜嗡嗡响，收音机里唱越剧。冰柜里只剩三根绿豆冰棍。她拍「我」的肩膀先开口，划拳划得很大声。
staging.en: Outside the shop, the freezer humming, Yue opera on the radio. Three mung-bean popsicles left. She slaps my shoulder and speaks first; the rock-paper-scissors is loud.

text.zh: 喂阿屿！石头剪刀布，输的请！
text.en: Oi, Ah-Yu! Rock-paper-scissors, loser pays!

text.zh: 你出布出了十年了。
text.en: You've thrown paper for ten years.

text.zh: 这叫战术！……你怎么还记得。
text.en: That's called strategy! ...How do you still remember that.

text.zh: 她拿了两根，一根塞给「我」，一根没拆，直接按在自己左膝上。
text.en: She takes two, shoves one at me, and presses the other, still wrapped, against her left knee.

text.zh: 看什么看，天热，给膝盖降降温。
text.en: What are you staring at. It's hot. My knee needs cooling too.

staging.zh: 晚自习后，操场只开着一盏灯。她做完一组跳跃，落地时左腿一软，坐在跑道上。她先笑，笑得很大声；「我」不笑。黄阿姨给的冰袋已经化成温水，她还按着。
staging.en: After evening study, one floodlight on the field. She finishes a set of jumps, lands, her left leg buckles and she sits down on the track. She laughs first, loudly; I don't. Auntie Huang's ice pack has melted to warm water and she still holds it there.

text.zh: 哈！跑道太滑了！谁洒的水！
text.en: Ha! The track's slippery! Who spilled water!

text.zh: 这里没有水。
text.en: There's no water here.

text.zh: ……阿屿，你小时候就这样，一点都不会配合别人撒谎。
text.en: ...Ah-Yu, you were like this as a kid. You never could play along with a lie.

text.zh: 别告诉郑教练。就这一次，这是我最后一次了。
text.en: Don't tell Coach Zheng. Just this once. This is my last chance.

unsaid.zh: 她怕的不是疼，是以后再也不能跑。
unsaid.en: What she fears isn't the pain; it's never running again.

staging.zh: 市体育场检录处，广播在点第四道的名字。她的膝盖在护膝底下肿出一圈。郑教练第一次结巴着先开口；她最后把发带解下来攥在手里，等「我」说话。
staging.en: The call room at the city stadium; the PA calls the name for lane four. Her knee bulges under the brace. Coach Zheng speaks first, stammering for once; at the end she takes off her headband, grips it, and waits for me.

text.zh: 夏、夏知遥，腿——你腿怎么回事！
text.en: X-Xia Zhiyao, your leg— what's wrong with your leg!

text.zh: 教练，我没事。
text.en: Coach, I'm fine.

text.zh: 阿屿。你说，我跑不跑。……你说什么，我都认。
text.en: Ah-Yu. You tell me. Do I run. ...Whatever you say, I'll take it.

text.zh: 她把白色发带解下来，攥在手心里。广播又念了一遍第四道。
text.en: She takes off the white headband and grips it. The PA calls lane four again.

unsaid.zh: 她想听的不是「跑」或「别跑」，是「我在」。
unsaid.en: What she wants to hear isn't "run" or "don't"; it's "I'm here."

title.en: Three Questions, One Pack of Spicy Sticks

staging.zh: 食堂排队的长龙里，她举着采访本挤到「我」前面，笔帽咬在嘴里。问题一个比一个离谱，最后一个突然正经。
staging.en: In the long canteen queue she squeezes in front of me with her notebook, pen cap between her teeth. Each question wilder than the last; the final one suddenly serious.

text.zh: 学长，三个问题，一包辣条。第一题：你对本校番茄炒蛋怎么评价？
text.en: Senior, three questions, one pack of spicy sticks. Question one: your verdict on our tomato-and-egg?

text.zh: 蛋呢？
text.en: Where's the egg?

text.zh: 好的，「转学生痛批食堂蛋量不足」。第二题——算了第二题跳过。
text.en: Got it: "New Kid Slams Canteen Egg Shortage". Question two— skip question two.

text.zh: 第三题：你昨天在天台待到九点四十，是去看星星，还是看人？
text.en: Question three: you were on the roof until 9:40 last night. Stars, or people?

text.zh: 不回答也是一种回答。这个可以写。
text.en: No comment is also a comment. This I can use.

staging.zh: 放学后的校报编辑部，只剩她一个人，空调开得太足。抽屉拉开一半，两沓稿子并排；一沓上面压着红笔批注。她用「假设性问题」开口，说到「妈妈」时把笔帽咬裂了。
staging.en: The paper's office after class, only her left, the air-con too cold. A drawer half open, two drafts side by side; one covered in red-pen notes. She opens with a "hypothetical", and bites her pen cap until it cracks when she says "mother".

text.zh: 学长，问你个假设性的问题。
text.en: Senior, a hypothetical question.

text.zh: 如果一个人的妈妈，是周主任。
text.en: Suppose someone's mother is Director Zhou.

text.zh: 笔帽在她嘴里「咔」地响了一声，裂了。
text.en: The pen cap goes crack between her teeth.

text.zh: 你说，我交哪一篇？
text.en: You tell me. Which one do I file?

text.zh: 你自己想交哪一篇？
text.en: Which one do you want to file?

text.zh: ……我想交的那篇，没有人布置。
text.en: ...The one I want to file, nobody assigned.

unsaid.zh: 她怕妈妈读完以后，还是只问「吃饭了没有」。
unsaid.en: She fears that after reading it, her mother will still only ask "have you eaten".

staging.zh: 行政楼三楼的档案柜前，「我」帮学生会搬档案。她指挥得一丝不苟。天文社那只档案袋最厚，边角磨起了毛。她看见「我」注意到了，语气更客气了。
staging.en: At the file cabinets on the admin building's third floor, I'm carrying files for the council. She directs with precision. The astronomy folder is the thickest, its corners worn soft. She sees me notice and becomes even more polite.

text.zh: 这位同学，档案按拼音排。天文社在 T。
text.en: Files go in pinyin order. Astronomy is under T.

text.zh: 这份怎么旧成这样？
text.en: Why is this one so worn?

text.zh: 天文社，成立六年，档案四十一页。……我只是看得比较仔细。
text.en: Astronomy club: six years, forty-one pages of records. ...I simply read carefully.

text.zh: 请你理解，看得仔细，是我的工作。
text.en: I trust you understand. Reading carefully is my job.

staging.zh: 行政楼的消防楼梯，感应灯每三十秒灭一次，她一次也不去跺脚，就在黑里说。她用数字讲那一夜，不讲感受。讲完，她从口袋里摸出一个易拉罐拉环，转一圈，放回去。
staging.en: The admin building's fire stairs; the motion light goes out every thirty seconds and she never stamps to wake it, just talks in the dark. She tells that night in numbers, not feelings. Afterwards she takes a ring-pull from her pocket, turns it once, and puts it back.

text.zh: 去年八月，流星雨那晚，九点二十分。县医院三楼，走廊第七把椅子。
text.en: Last August, the meteor night, 9:20 p.m. County hospital, third floor, the seventh chair in the corridor.

text.zh: 数字我记得很准。你知道的。
text.en: I remember numbers precisely. You know that.

text.zh: 你为什么不告诉她？
text.en: Why didn't you tell her?

text.zh: 说了，就像在找借口。按规定，迟到就是迟到。
text.en: Saying it would sound like an excuse. By the rules, late is late.

text.zh: 感应灯灭了。黑里有一声很轻的金属响，是拉环碰到了指甲。
text.en: The light goes out. In the dark, a faint metallic click: the ring-pull against a fingernail.

unsaid.en: She wants to come back to the club.

staging.zh: 学生会会议室，门缝里漏出冷气，走廊挤满了人。周主任念到「天文社」。温璃手里的签字笔笔帽一直没拔。周主任先开口，温璃用章程回答，最后一句不是章程。
staging.en: The council room, cold air leaking under the door, the hall packed. Director Zhou reaches "astronomy club". Wen Li's pen stays capped. Director Zhou speaks first; Wen Li answers with the rulebook; her last line is not from it.

text.zh: 温璃同学，签字。
text.en: Wen Li. Sign.

text.zh: 请稍等。按章程，社员满三人的社团不予撤销。
text.en: One moment. Per the charter, a club with three members may not be cut.

text.zh: 天文社，社员两人。数据说话。
text.en: Astronomy club, two members. The data speaks.

text.zh: ……我在找第三个人。请你理解，我找了一年。
text.en: ...I am looking for the third. I trust you understand: I have looked for a year.

unsaid.zh: 第三个人可以是她自己。

commonGoal.zh: 共通线：群像为主，五个人都要露面，各自只露出一个反常的小细节（日历、步子、相机、袖章、零花钱）；笑多泪少，只埋伏笔不揭底。
commonGoal.en: Common route: ensemble first; all five appear, each showing one odd little detail (a calendar, a stride, a camera, an armband, pocket money). More laughs than tears; plant, never reveal.

goal.zh: 个人线·小满：天文社的存亡就是她的存亡；修镜子、招人、天台；温璃的旧事从她的视角一点点被误读。
goal.en: Xiaoman route: the club's survival is hers; repairs, recruiting, the roof; Wen Li's past seen, and misread, through her eyes.

others.zh: 其他人退到背景，但会记得「我」没来：知遥不再叫阿屿，清漪的书签只写一个字。
others.en: Others step back but remember I wasn't there: Zhiyao stops saying Ah-Yu, Qingyi's bookmark notes shrink to one word.

goal.zh: 个人线·清漪：倒计时的恋爱；书、书签、江边；一切都在变少。
goal.en: Qingyi route: a love on a countdown; books, bookmarks, the river; everything getting fewer.

others.zh: 知遥察觉「我」总往图书馆跑，补课时故意气清漪；小满一个人修镜子。
others.en: Zhiyao notices I keep going to the library and needles Qingyi in tutoring; Xiaoman fixes the telescope alone.

goal.zh: 个人线·知遥：发小重逢变成并肩；膝伤、冰袋、夜里的操场；成长是学会说疼。
goal.en: Zhiyao route: childhood friends become partners; the knee, the ice, the night track; growing up means learning to say it hurts.

others.zh: 大川把情报卖得越来越贵；清漪补课时多看了「我」两眼又移开。
others.en: Dachuan's tips get pricier; in tutoring Qingyi glances at me twice and looks away.

goal.zh: 个人线·一诺：追新闻变成追真相；两篇稿子、妈妈、头版；她学会署自己的名。
goal.en: Yinuo route: chasing news becomes chasing truth; two drafts, a mother, the front page; she learns to sign her own name.

others.zh: 小满以为「我」在帮校报对付天文社，冷着脸；温璃按规定公事公办。
others.en: Xiaoman thinks I'm helping the paper against the club and goes cold; Wen Li stays strictly by the rules.

goal.zh: 个人线·温璃：规矩背后的人；档案、消防楼梯、第三个名字；她学会把自己写进去。
goal.en: Wen Li route: the person behind the rules; files, fire stairs, the third name; she learns to write herself in.

others.zh: 小满发现「我」和「那个人」走得近，觉得被背叛了第二次。
others.en: Xiaoman sees me with "that person" and feels betrayed a second time.

ensemble.zh: 群像线：谁都没有走太近；故事重心放在天文社的存亡和大家一起的夏天，误会靠群体而非一个人解开。
ensemble.en: Ensemble route: no one too close; the weight shifts to the club's survival and the summer together, misunderstandings untangled by the group rather than one person.

text.zh: 看过小满的真结局后，温璃线的真相才完整：那张观测表是两个人的。
text.en: After Xiaoman's true ending, Wen Li's truth becomes whole: the observation sheet belonged to both of them.

truth.zh: 温璃没收天台钥匙不是刁难：去年那晚以后，她怕小满一个人在天台待到深夜，又是没人来。
truth.en: Wen Li didn't confiscate the roof key to be petty: since last year she has been afraid Xiaoman would sit up there alone late at night, with no one coming, again.

reframes.zh: 第 3 天她在天台门口看着小满的背影站了很久
reframes.en: on Day 3 she stood watching Xiaoman's back for a long time

reframes.zh: 「数字不会因为谁难过就变」是说给她自己听的
reframes.en: "numbers don't change because someone is sad" was said to herself

reframes.zh: 天文社那只磨毛了的档案袋
reframes.en: the astronomy folder worn soft at the edges

truth.zh: 知遥桌上每天那根没署名的冰棍，是大川买的。她一直以为是「我」。
truth.en: The unsigned popsicle on Zhiyao's desk every day was from Dachuan. She always thought it was me.

reframes.zh: 大川那句「你别跟她说冰棍是我买的」
reframes.en: Dachuan's "don't tell her the popsicles were from me"

reframes.zh: 知遥第一次对「我」笑得那么认真，是在冰棍出现的第二天
reframes.en: Zhiyao first smiled at me that earnestly the day after the popsicles began

truth.zh: 那台望远镜是方既白毕业前弄坏的。小满省吃俭用修的，是她偶像留下的烂摊子。
truth.en: The telescope was broken by Fang Jibai before he graduated. What Xiaoman scrimped to repair was a mess her idol left behind.

reframes.zh: 那个背星图纸筒的大学生盯着门牌看了很久
reframes.en: the college boy with the star-chart tube staring at the nameplate

reframes.zh: 小满说「方学长要是在，就好了」
reframes.en: Xiaoman saying "if only Fang were here"

truth.zh: （二周目）清漪赶「我」离开靠窗座位，是因为那个位置正对老陈的办公室——那几天她在等出国材料的章。
truth.en: (Second playthrough) Qingyi evicted me from the window seat because it faces Old Chen's office; those days she was waiting for her papers to be stamped.

reframes.zh: 第一次见面那句「图书馆不是让你睡觉的地方」
reframes.en: the first-meeting line "the library is not a place to nap"

reframes.zh: 老陈每次路过图书馆都放慢脚步
reframes.en: Old Chen slowing down every time he passed the library

text.zh: 小时候的巷子口，她摔破了膝盖不哭，反而把「我」的冰棍抢过去按在伤口上。
text.en: The mouth of our childhood lane: she skinned her knee and didn't cry; she grabbed my popsicle and pressed it on the cut instead.

text.zh: 去年的天台：一张填了一半的观测表，两只手电，一只一直没亮。
text.en: Last year's roof: an observation sheet half filled in, two flashlights, one that never switched on.

text.zh: 医院走廊的日光灯嗡嗡响，售货机吐出一罐汽水，她拉开拉环，一口没喝。
text.en: The hospital corridor's strip lights humming; the vending machine drops a can; she pulls the ring and never drinks.

text.zh: 三年前的天台，一个高一男生拿手电依次点过三颗亮星，旁边两个初中女生在记。
text.en: Three years ago on the roof: a first-year boy pointing a flashlight at three bright stars in turn, two middle-school girls taking notes beside him.

text.zh: 搬走那天，巷子里有人追着车跑了很远，额头上绑着一根白布条。
text.en: The day we moved away, someone chased the car a long way down the lane, a strip of white cloth tied round her forehead.

weather.en: muggy, a passing shower after lunch

bits.en: the ink smell of new textbooks

bits.zh: 「我」的校服还是外地学校的款式，颜色不一样
bits.en: my uniform is still the old school's, the wrong colour

bits.zh: 黑板角落写着「距暑假 13 天」
bits.en: "13 days to summer" in the corner of the blackboard

bits.zh: 公告栏新贴的核查表，糨糊还没干
bits.en: the new audit list on the noticeboard, paste still wet

weather.en: stifling, not a breath of wind

bits.zh: 食堂今天的番茄炒蛋只有番茄
复习资料多得课桌塞不下，有人用橡皮筋捆在椅背上
bits.en: so many review sheets that someone straps them to a chair back with rubber bands

weather.zh: 雷阵雨前的低气压，蜻蜓飞得很低
weather.en: low pressure before a storm; dragonflies flying low

bits.zh: 老陈的保温杯里泡的是菊花
bits.en: Old Chen's thermos holds chrysanthemum tea

weather.zh: 大晴天，考场里吊扇不转
weather.en: blazing; the exam room fans are off

bits.zh: 考场外的走廊里，有人在背化学方程式
bits.en: someone in the hall reciting chemical equations
red circles on the results sheet

bits.zh: 江边有人在放风筝，线断了
bits.en: someone flying a kite by the river; the string snaps

bits.zh: 行政楼走廊里，挤满了来等结果的人
bits.en: the admin hallway crammed with people waiting for results

weather.zh: 晴，夜里能看见银河的一角
weather.en: clear; at night a corner of the Milky Way

bits.zh: 教室里开始有人收拾抽屉
bits.en: people start clearing out their desks

weather.zh: 烈日，体育场的塑胶跑道烫脚
weather.en: blazing sun; the stadium track burns underfoot

bits.zh: 号码布用四个别针别在背心上
bits.en: race bibs pinned on with four safety pins

bits.zh: 江边河灯和糖画摊，糖稀的焦味
bits.en: river lanterns and sugar-painting stalls, the smell of burnt syrup

weather.zh: 清晨薄雾，太阳出来就散
weather.en: morning mist that lifts with the sun

bits.zh: 最后一天，没人认真听课
bits.en: the last day; nobody really listens in class

classroom.zh: 课桌上刻着上一届的名字
classroom.en: a previous class's names carved into a desk

classroom.zh: 后排有人用课本挡着睡觉
classroom.en: someone in the back row asleep behind a textbook

canteen.zh: 打饭阿姨的勺子抖三下
canteen.en: the server's ladle shakes three times

canteen.zh: 不锈钢餐盘碰在一起的响声

shop.zh: 冰柜的门要用膝盖顶一下才关得上
shop.en: the freezer door only shuts with a knee bump

shop.zh: 收音机里的越剧唱到一半跳了台
shop.en: the Yue opera on the radio jumps stations mid-aria

library.zh: 借书登记本上的圆珠笔绑着一根绳
library.en: the ballpoint on the sign-out ledger is tied on with string

astro.zh: 器材室墙上的星图褪色了，猎户座只剩半个
astro.en: the faded star chart on the storeroom wall, Orion only half there

track.zh: 跑道边的饮水机永远是温的
track.en: the water fountain by the track is always lukewarm

roof.zh: 晾在天台的校服被风吹到栏杆上
roof.en: a drying uniform blown against the railing

oldstreet.zh: 馄饨摊老板用一把蒲扇赶苍蝇
oldstreet.en: the wonton seller swats flies with a palm fan

river.zh: 堤上有老人拉二胡，拉错一个音又从头来
river.en: an old man on the embankment playing erhu, starting over after every wrong note

council.zh: 复印机卡纸，走廊里一股热碳粉味
council.en: the copier jams; the hall smells of hot toner

any.zh: 晚自习铃响之前的十秒，整栋楼突然安静
any.en: the ten seconds before the evening-study bell, when the whole building goes quiet

any.zh: 有人的自行车铃坏了，只能「咔」一声
any.en: someone's bike bell is broken; it only goes "clack"

text.zh: 大川和一诺都用辣条买情报，两人发现对方压价，当场在食堂谈起了「汇率」。
text.en: Dachuan and Yinuo both buy gossip in spicy sticks; finding out the other is undercutting them, they negotiate an "exchange rate" in the canteen.

text.zh: 老陈说「我讲两句」，全班开始默数；数到第二十一句时，他发现大家在数。
text.en: Old Chen says "just two words" and the whole class starts counting silently; at sentence twenty-one he realizes what they're doing.

text.zh: 大川的校服扣子又扣错了一颗，他坚持说这是「情报员的暗号」。
text.en: Dachuan's buttons are one hole off again; he insists it's "an informant's secret signal".

text.zh: 郑教练来小卖部买水，哨子挂在脖子上，黄阿姨让他别对着她的收音机吹。
text.en: Coach Zheng comes to the shop for water, whistle round his neck; Auntie Huang warns him not to blow it at her radio.

text.zh: 老陈训完人塞橘子，大川故意犯点小错，就为了一个橘子。
text.en: Old Chen hands out an orange after every scolding, so Dachuan commits small offences just to get one.

text.zh: 「那个小姑娘的膝盖哦……我什么都没说啊。」
text.en: "That girl's knee... I didn't say anything, mind."

text.zh: 「温璃天天在天台盯天文社的窗，肯定是在抓违纪。」
text.en: "Wen Li stares at the club window from the roof every day. Definitely hunting rule-breakers."

text.zh: 「沈清漪的事你们别打听。……哎，她那本书还了没有。」
text.en: "Leave Shen Qingyi's business alone. ...Hm, did she return that book."

text.zh: 「校报那个小记者，写东西还是太感情用事。」——说的时候嘴角往上提了一下。
text.en: "That cub reporter on the paper is too sentimental." She almost smiles saying it.

text.zh: 「小林还是那么倔。……镜子的事，你先别跟她讲。」
text.en: "Little Lin is as stubborn as ever. ...Don't tell her about the telescope yet."

text.zh: 「那个熊猫一样的同学，天天来看训练，是想进田径队吧？」
text.en: "That panda-ish kid who watches practice every day, he wants to join the team, right?"

text.zh: 「转学生这礼拜买了三次冰棍，每次两根。」
text.en: "The new boy bought popsicles three times this week. Two each time."

habits.zh: 进器材室先看入社表还在不在
habits.en: checks the form is still there whenever she enters

contradiction.zh: 嘴上赶人走，最怕人真的走
contradiction.en: tells people to leave; dreads that they will

growth.zh: 从一个人硬撑，到肯开口要人留下
growth.en: from holding it up alone to asking someone to stay

style.zh: 记账本一样的日记：日期、天气、几颗星、几个人，感叹号很多，心事写在括号里
style.en: a diary like a ledger: date, weather, stars counted, people present; lots of exclamation marks, feelings in brackets

hides.zh: 修镜子花了多少钱；还有她其实还在等「那个人」
hides.en: what the repair cost; and that she is still waiting for "that person"

seesMe.zh: 凑数的转学生，能用就行
seesMe.en: a new kid to make up numbers; good enough

seesMe.zh: 吵起来挺好玩的那个人
seesMe.en: the one who is fun to bicker with
(will he leave too?)

seesMe.zh: 唯一一个知道镜子的事的人
seesMe.en: the only one who knows about the telescope
I want him on the roof

dejaVu.zh: 「你以前……是不是也帮我捡过这把螺丝刀？」
dejaVu.en: "Did you... pick up this screwdriver for me before?"

dejaVu.zh: 「怪了，你一来，我就想先看看天气预报。」
dejaVu.en: "Weird. When you show up I want to check the forecast first."

awayVoice.zh: 「诶——你人呢！镜子我一个人擦完了！」
awayVoice.en: "Hey—where are you! I cleaned the telescope by myself!"

awayVoice.zh: 「……天台今晚是晴的。我就说一下。」

habits.zh: 翻书时用书签而不是折角
看手机日历，看完扣在桌上
habits.en: checks her calendar and lays the phone face down

contradiction.en: she never lies, so she can only stay silent

growth.zh: 从「别对我太好」到允许自己被记住
growth.en: from "don't be too kind to me" to letting herself be remembered

style.zh: 每天只写一句，像书的摘抄；从不写名字，用代称
style.en: one sentence a day, like a quotation; never names, only epithets

hides.en: the departure date; that she does not want to go

seesMe.en: the junior who took my seat
someone who finishes a book before borrowing the next
a book I cannot afford to borrow more of
someone I owe
where the light arrives

dejaVu.zh: 「这本你是不是借过。……不，是我记错了。」
dejaVu.en: "Haven't you borrowed this before. ...No, I'm misremembering."

awayVoice.en: "The wind by the river is blowing the right way tonight."

quirks.zh: 重复关键字掩饰：「酸！就是酸！」
